questions.q: What does cloudFiles.schemaEvolutionMode set to 'rescue' do when a new column arrives?
options: Routes the new field into the _rescued_data column instead of altering the table schema, without failing the batch
Immediately deletes the entire arriving file
Stops the stream permanently until manually restarted
Automatically drops the oldest column in the table to make room
questions.explain: Rescue mode never fails a batch — unexpected fields go into _rescued_data instead of changing the table's schema.

questions.q: What does the default addNewColumns mode do differently from rescue?
options: It adds the new column to the table going forward, failing the current micro-batch once so the schema updates before retry
It behaves identically to rescue in every situation
It permanently ignores all new columns forever
It requires manually writing a full StructType before any data can be read
questions.explain: addNewColumns actually alters the table schema, briefly failing the current batch so the update takes effect before the retry.

questions.q: What is stored in the _rescued_data column?
options: A JSON string with any field that didn't fit the current schema, plus the source file path
A copy of the entire original file, unparsed
Only column names that were successfully matched to the schema
Nothing — the column is always empty by design
questions.explain: _rescued_data quarantines unexpected fields as JSON rather than silently dropping them.

questions.q: What does cloudFiles.schemaHints let you do?
options: Pin specific columns to a known-correct type, overriding what inference guesses from sample files
Disable schema inference completely for every column
Automatically generate documentation for the inferred schema
Force Auto Loader to use file notification mode instead of directory listing
questions.explain: schemaHints corrects specific columns inference gets wrong, without requiring a fully hand-written schema.

questions.q: According to this lesson, what did Databricks & Delta Lake Lesson 32 actually say about schema evolution?
options: Only one sentence — that Auto Loader infers a schema and can detect changes automatically, without naming the actual modes
It fully explained all four schemaEvolutionMode options in detail
It explained the _rescued_data column in depth
It covered schemaHints as a way to override inference
questions.explain: Lesson 32 mentioned schema evolution only briefly; this lesson covers the actual modes, the rescue column, and schemaHints in depth.
